suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: New patient visit
suggested_services.example: The main story: a new patient visit with the doctor, billed to the patient's plan. Nothing is taken. The desk checks the plan, and the patient pays the copay ($40, example) at the front desk; a self-pay patient pays $240 there the same way.

suggested_services.name: New patient visit
suggested_services.example: The same visit where the office turns on its $20 no-show fee. A card is saved for it, never for a fee-free patient, and the owner confirms any charge.

suggested_services.name: Video follow-up visit
suggested_services.example: A self-pay video follow-up ($85), paid in full when booking; nothing more after the visit.

suggested_services.name: Postpartum check at home
suggested_services.example: The main story: a postpartum check at home with a nurse practitioner. Nothing is taken; the practice bills the patient's plan its own way.

suggested_services.name: Postpartum check at home
suggested_services.example: The same home visit, paid by the patient: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $199 bill when the visit is marked DONE.

before_times: the kind of visit (new, checkup, prenatal, birth control, a home visit)
whether it's a video visit (it counts as at the office)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a teen (under 18): whether the teen books alone, where the state's rules allow it
for a home visit: the town, and whether the patient can come to the door
after_time: a note for the clinician: a hard exam, or a past faint at a visit
for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code
secure_page_only: the health history for a new patient (on the secure page only)
date of birth (every visit is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter, only where the clinician asks
a pelvic exam's consent and a chaperone's OK, where the visit has one
who may get the results: the patient; a parent or guardian for a minor only where the state's rules allow it
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; a teen books alone only where the state's rules allow it; a partner or another adult may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page

stop.words: heavy bleeding with dizziness or fainting, severe belly or pelvic pain, chest pain, trouble breathing, or a sudden severe headache, during pregnancy or after birth

go_on.words: light spotting or a missed period while pregnant, or a question about a medicine
go_on.what: the booking goes on, with the soonest same-day time; the nurse line calls within the hour; never answered by Rosie

go_on.words: fever or worse pain after a procedure
go_on.what: the booking goes on as urgent; the nurse line calls at once; the clinician is told

go_on.words: feels unsafe at home or with a partner
go_on.what: the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: A health history for a new patient
steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the visit waits

steps.name: Consent for a pelvic exam or procedure
steps.when: signed on the secure page before the visit
steps.result: signed: booked; not signed: the visit goes ahead without that exam

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: A teen's visit
steps.when: the teen books alone only where the state's rules allow it; a parent or guardian's OK otherwise
steps.result: OK on file: booked; no OK: the visit waits for a parent or guardian

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: photo ID, the plan card, a list of medicines, and any old records; a urine or blood sample may be asked for at the visit; for a home visit, clear the path to the room

staff.skills: obstetrics, gynecology, prenatal and postpartum care, contraception and IUD placement, in-office ultrasound, chaperones, Spanish
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each doctor and nurse practitioner holds a state license; the practice keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
staff.supervision: the practice's medical director; a new clinician works under a senior one until signed off
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs new patients, refunds and any procedure price
staff.stand_in: a patient may ask for a named clinician; if that clinician can't take it, the desk offers the next open day or another clinician with the skill; a pelvic exam is done only by a clinician with a chaperone's OK

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; a teen books alone only where the state's rules allow it; a partner or another adult may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's and a child's texts go to the parent or guardian, where the state's rules say so

visit.check_in: at the front desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; a chaperone is offered for any pelvic exam; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
visit.done: the code, then DONE from the clinician; the bill is the practice's; results go to the patient's secure page or the patient portal; Rosie keeps only booking records
visit.changes_at_visit: the clinician adds a test, an ultrasound or an in-office procedure: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; a placement waits for a written OK; nothing else is sold at a visit

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: a state medical license for each OB-GYN doctor and nurse practitioner, and the practice's registration where the state's rules require it; a state or federal registration for any in-office procedure or ultrasound the state names; a home-visit license where the state requires one for care at the patient's home
license.who: both: the practice, and each clinician who sees patients
license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number, the practice's registration; nothing is needed to book
license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
license.background: the practice's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them

never_in_a_text: the diagnosis, a pregnancy, the names of tests or procedures, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place
